title: Azuma sqrt(2 ln m) inflation = additive-vs-multiplicative gap: replace the additive level-sum cocycle by the multiplicative Jacobi-sum cocycle (Hasse-Davenport tower) with NO bulk-vs-tail loss
wall: W-BGK / W-Paley (with the Azuma bulk-vs-tail gap W-anomaly reappearing identically in the multiplicative reframing). The Hasse-Davenport cocycle governs INDIVIDUAL Gauss/Jacobi sums; the house cancellation lives in the AVERAGE T(phi)=(1/m)sum_i J(chi^i,phi) over the m terms, i.e. in the additive geometry of {1-w : w in mu_n}, which the multiplicative cocycle is blind to. The sqrt(ln m) L-infty-vs-L^2 gap is NOT removed by going multiplicative; it reappears verbatim on T_h. Lifting F_q->F_{q^2} just produces a fresh generic tangent sum over a bigger field = the same 25-year-open BGK/Paley sqrt-cancellation, relocated, not eased.
evidence: Two exact/high-precision probes at PROPER dyadic subgroups mu_n < F_q* in/near the prize regime. PROBE 1 (scripts/probes/_407_conn/C070_jacobi_cocycle.py, prize-regime beta=2.5-3.5, n<<sqrt q): the multiplicative tangent sum T_h = (1/m)sum_i J(chi^i, chi^h) has EXACTLY the SAME bulk-vs-tail (L-infty-vs-L^2) gap that defeated the additive Azuma route. rmsT/sqrt(n) ~ 1.25-1.61 (generic L^2 sqrt(n) cancellation), but maxT/sqrt(n) GROWS with m (2.37 at m=65 -> 3.28 at m=1025), and maxT/rmsT ~= sqrt(ln m) at every config (n=8 m=65: 1.90 vs sqrt(ln m)=2.04; n=16 m=258: 2.06 vs 2.36; n=32 m=363: 3.23 vs 2.43; n=16 m=1026: 2.43 vs 2.63). maxT/sqrt(n ln m) PLATEAUS at ~1.2-1.8 = the SAME sqrt(n ln m) extreme-value house law. So the L-infty-vs-L^2 sqrt(ln m) loss is NOT an artifact of additivity -- it is present, identical, in the multiplicative tangent sum. PROBE 2 (scripts/probes/_407_conn/C070_hassedavenport_lift.py): built F_{q^2}=F_q[t]/(t^2-s), the lifted character chi'=chi o Norm, lifted subgroup ker'=Norm^{-1}(mu_n) (|ker'|=n(q+1), verified EXACT), and T'(phi')=sum_{W in ker', W!=1} phi'(1-W). (i) Hasse-Davenport CONFIRMED exact: |-g(chi') - (-g(chi))^2| < 3e-12, |g(chi')|=q exactly (n=8 p=73; n=16 p=257) -- the GAUSS-SUM cocycle is genuine, as known. (ii) But T does NOT inherit a bounded per-level multiplier: the would-be cocycle factor T'/T is WILDLY scattered -- n=8: T'/T in [4.50, 17.87], spread 13.4; n=16: T'/T in [1.00, 31.22], spread 30.2. A genuine cocycle requires a FIXED q-independent bounded multiplier; instead T'/T ranges over an order of magnitude. (iii) T' over F_{q^2} behaves GENERICALLY: |T'|/sqrt(|ker'|) is itself scattered (0.48-2.20), an independent fresh tangent sum over the bigger field with its OWN extreme-value scatter -- NOT 'T lifted'. The lift produced a new instance of the same open sqrt-cancellation problem at a larger field, retaining the bulk-vs-tail gap.
honest_note: The connection's UNDERLYING components are all TRUE and were verified, not disputed: (a) the Hasse-Davenport multiplicative cocycle for Gauss sums (-g(chi')=(-g(chi))^2) is exact (probe 2 sanity, 3e-12); (b) the in-tree identity I4 tangentSum_mul_orderOf_eq_sum_jacobiSum (TangentSumJacobiAverage.lean, axiom-clean) -- T(phi)=(1/m)sum_i J(chi^i,phi) -- is correct; (c) CumulantTowerAzumaWall.lean correctly proves the ADDITIVE Azuma tower inflates by sqrt(2 ln m). What is REFUTED is the OPERATIVE bet that going multiplicative removes the loss. The fatal gap: Hasse-Davenport is a cocycle on a SINGLE multiplicative object (one Gauss/Jacobi sum); but T is an AVERAGE of m Jacobi sums, and the house-determining cancellation is the sqrt(m)-cancellation IN THE AVERAGE (whether the m lifted terms add coherently or cancel). The cocycle acts term-by-term and says NOTHING about coherence among the m terms -- that coherence is the additive geometry of {1-w : w in mu_n} (the Sol-set / autocorrelation structure of RESEARCH_SYNTHESIS_407_TANGENT.md sec 5b), exactly the BGK/Paley object the multiplicative reframing cannot see. Probe 1 makes this concrete: the SAME sqrt(ln m) bulk-vs-tail gap the additive Azuma paid is present in T_h itself, so 'doing the cocycle multiplicatively' does not eliminate it. Probe 2 confirms there is NO bounded multiplicative descent law for T across the lift (T'/T scatters over 10x; T' is a fresh generic sum). Honesty: probe 2 ran at small beta (~2.0) to keep |F_{q^2}|<=66k enumerable in exact arithmetic; probe 1 covers the genuine prize regime (beta 2.5-3.5, n<<sqrt q) and is where the sqrt(ln m) gap claim is established. No closure is claimed; the route welds back to the W-BGK/W-Paley sqrt-cancellation wall (and re-exhibits the W-anomaly gap), confirming C070 OPEN. Suggested DISPROOF_LOG one-liner: 'C070 -- Jacobi/Hasse-Davenport cocycle is genuine for single Gauss/Jacobi sums but T is their AVERAGE; cocycle is blind to coherence-among-terms = the BGK cancellation; multiplicative T_h carries the SAME sqrt(ln m) bulk-vs-tail gap (maxT/rmsT ~= sqrt(ln m)) and the F_q->F_{q^2} lift gives no bounded multiplier (T'/T spread >10x) -- welds back to BGK/Paley.'
